mapper.insert: insert into cms_forum_favorite (post_id, user_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.delete: delete from cms_forum_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from cms_forum_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and post_id = #{postId}

select p.id, p.title, p.content, p.images, p.user_id, p.status, p.is_deleted, p.audit_reason, p.create_time, p.update_time from cms_forum_post p inner join cms_forum_favorite f on f.post_id = p.id where f.user_id = #{userId} and p.is_deleted = 0 order by f.create_time desc
